EPISODE 1: The Contract

[00:00] INT. CITY HOSPITAL - CORRIDOR - NIGHT
[00:02] Maya Chen, 26, runs down the corridor in a soaked delivery jacket.
[00:06] MAYA: My sister Lily Chen was brought in an hour ago. Where is she?
[00:10] NURSE: Room 4. She needs surgery tonight. Forty thousand dollars, upfront.
[00:15] Maya sinks against the wall.
[00:18] MAYA: I deliver food for a living. Where am I supposed to find that?
[00:22] A man in a courier jacket, Ethan, 31, waits by the vending machine. He has heard everything.
[00:29] ETHAN: I can pay for the surgery. Marry me for one year. Contract only.
[00:33] MAYA: You're a courier. You can't even afford a coffee.
[00:36] ETHAN: Let's just say I have savings.
[00:40] INT. STERLING MANSION - STUDY - NIGHT
[00:42] Rose Sterling, 78, Ethan's grandmother, taps her cane on the marble floor.
[00:46] ROSE: Find a wife by Friday, Ethan, or the company goes to Victor.
[00:50] Victor Hale, Ethan's cousin, smirks from the doorway.
[00:53] VICTOR: Tick tock, cousin.
[00:56] EXT. CITY HOSPITAL - NIGHT
[00:58] Maya signs the contract on the seat of a delivery scooter.
[01:02] MAYA: One year. No feelings.
[01:05] ETHAN: No feelings.
[01:08] Ethan's phone lights up with a board meeting reminder. He hides the screen before Maya can see it.
[01:14] TO BE CONTINUED
